story_type: stranded on a rock by incoming surf, swimmer hoist
hook: The tide came in and trapped him on a rock in the surf.
narration: The tide came in, and the surf trapped a man on a rock near Hug Point, Oregon.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk from Sector Columbia River came in over the breaking waves.
Its rescue swimmer rode the cable down to the rock, straight into the spray.
The pilot can't see below the helicopter, so the flight mechanic talks him into position, a few feet at a time.
[short pause] Then the swimmer and the man came up together on the hook.
outcome: The man was hoisted aboard and taken back to Sector Columbia River with no medical concerns.
title: Trapped on a rock as the tide came in
description:
On April 10, 2017, a Coast Guard Sector Columbia River MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted a man who was stranded on a rock by incoming surf near Hug Point, Oregon.
